_comment: Lexical banned-token vocabulary. Each token must appear exactly ONCE in this file; scan.py asserts that so the data file cannot become a hiding place. AST-detected patterns (copy-tree, sleep, evaluate-sentinel, grid-fallback) are defined in scan.py because they are shapes, not strings.

proc-kill.why: spec 4.5: the pattern-matching broadcast killer matches the invoking shell's own argv and kills the caller (reproduced first-hand, exit 144). A.7 requires terminating the specific Popen child.

loopback-host.why: spec 4.5/4.6: use 127.0.0.1. serve.py prints a hostname-bearing URL, so B.1's port parse must be token-free.
